sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:47558
Court No. - 12

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11175 of 2023
Applicant :- Satish Verma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Arun Singh Somvanshi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

In terms of the F.I.R., a missing person report was lodged on 28.1.2020 alleging therein that the daughter of the informant was missing since 10.1.2020 and was allegedly enticed away by the applicant.
The said version was also supported by the neighbour Bal Govind.
Subsequently, the victim died during COVID.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has drawn my attention to the post mortem report which indicates that cause of death could not be ascertained.
The witness further did not support the prosecution story in its cross examination recorded during trial.

The applicant is languishing in jail since 27.7.2020, hence, the right of speedy trial enshrined under Article 21 of the Constitution of Satish Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28678094/

entities.text: Constitution of Satish Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: India has been adversely affected and the applicant is suffering pre trial detention.

Furthermore,
there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in near future as only one witness has been examined so far.
Hence, the applicant having no criminal history, may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the statement of the witness coupled with the fact that the applicant has suffered pre trial detention of more than four years who is languishing in jail since 27.7.2020, there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in near future as only one witness has been examined, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Satish Verma be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.66 of 2020, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 5(J)(2)/6 of the POCSO Act, Police Station Gola, District Lakhimpur Kheri on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 Shukla  Satish Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28678094/
